detail.longDescription: The URL is to a public stack page. Without an account you can view the supplement catalog. It contains over 300 supplements. Yes it is AI generated but through a fairly long process that involves pulling the latest research, finding sources for supplement dosage and discovering contraindications, interactions and synergies between supplements. If you're into taking health supplements, it's a great app. I made it for myself initially then just kept going with it, adding features that I wanted as I went along. Now it can even scan your supplement bottles for whats inside and it's pretty accurate. If you're using the phone app and know how to take a picture it will read your bottle correctly. Open to honest feedback from people who actually use a lot of supplements. If you do make an account, it's free, no paid tier or even ads.
